✳Message to your agentinstall.txt 
Help me install OrcaSlicer Agent from https://github.com/outsid3rx/OrcaSlicer and connect it to my AI agent through MCP.

Read the README and docs/agent/INSTALL.md for the selected version. Check my OS, architecture and available releases. MCP is client-independent: use my current stdio-capable client; ask which one if it is unclear. Use a compatible build of this fork with AgentControl, and verify the manifest and checksums. If the required files or a compatible release are unavailable, explain this and stop. Stock OrcaSlicer is not a replacement for this fork.

Before replacing the app, help preserve my projects and any custom certificate added inside the .app bundle. Do not delete profiles, the recipe database or operation journals.

Install MCP and the skill with the provided scripts/agent/install.sh. Use the appropriate --client flags for clients supported by the installer. For other clients, get the generic stdio configuration and add the bundled skill as documented by the client. If it does not support skills, use the skill's instructions as agent guidance. If uv is needed, explain how it will be installed. Run doctor and help reconnect MCP.

Ask which model and export folders I want to allow. Launch Orca with ORCA_AGENT_CONTROL=1 and those folders. Through MCP, check orca_list_instances, explicit window selection and available capabilities. A successful doctor check alone does not prove that an Orca window is connected.

Do not enable ORCA_AGENT_PRINTING=1 or send anything to a printer during installation. Finish by reporting versions, the MCP executable location and verification results.
A readable prompt. No hidden commands.

The project is evolving. Check what is included in the available release before installing. Check releases ↗

02 Prefer to install manually?+

These steps are for macOS Apple Silicon. You will need the fork build, MCP installer archive and uv. Other platforms are not verified by these instructions.

  1. Get a compatible release

    Open the fork's releases. Find the DMG and installer archive from the same release, and verify release-manifest.json and SHA256SUMS. If they are unavailable, wait for a release; stock OrcaSlicer will not work.

  2. Install OrcaSlicer

    Save your projects and close the app. Drag the build from the DMG into Applications. The public DMG does not include a personal Bambuddy CA: keep a separate copy before replacing the app.

  3. Install MCP and the skill

    Extract the installer archive and open a terminal in its folder. Install MCP, then add the generated configuration to your client. The installer preserves unrelated client settings and creates backups. 

    ./scripts/agent/install.sh install
./scripts/agent/install.sh doctor

    Without --client the installer installs the server and prints stdio configuration for your client. Add the skill from skills/orca-mcp-control/ using your client's documentation; if skills are not supported, use its instructions as agent guidance. For automatic Codex or ZCode setup, add --client codex or --client zcode to the commands above.

  4. Enable slicer control

    Create model and export folders. Replace the examples below with their existing absolute paths, then launch the binary directly. Opening the app icon normally does not enable the API. 

    ORCA_AGENT_CONTROL=1 \
ORCA_AGENT_INPUT_ROOTS='["/Users/you/3D/models"]' \
ORCA_AGENT_OUTPUT_ROOTS='["/Users/you/3D/exports"]' \
/Applications/OrcaSlicer.app/Contents/MacOS/OrcaSlicer

    If Orca is already open without the API, save your project and close it first. Changing environment variables does not change an existing process.

  5. Check the connection

    Ask your agent to call orca_list_instances, choose the intended session_id / window_id pair and read the window's capabilities. Multiple windows are supported. No test print is needed to check the connection.

Good questions

Let's
clear things up.

Have another question?
Let's talk on GitHub ↗

Is this the official OrcaSlicer?+

No. This is an unofficial open-source fork of OrcaSlicerthat adds a native AgentControl API for external agents to work with the current project, settings and devices. A separate MCP server connects that API to your AI client.

Which AI agents can I use?+

Any client that supports MCP over stdio, such as Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf or ZCode. The installer can configure Codex and ZCode automatically; without --client it prints generic configuration for other clients. MCP availability depends on the client's version and settings; you choose the AI model.

Can my agent send a print right away?+

No. The API is disabled on normal launches. ORCA_AGENT_CONTROL=1 enables slicer control, and the selected folders limit file imports and exports. Sending jobs and controlling the device separately require ORCA_AGENT_PRINTING=1 in Orca's environment. The installation prompt does not enable it.

Will it ask before sending a print?+

The skill requires permission before sending, except for a job you have already explicitly approved or a printer whose name contains virtual . The report includes time, material estimates, a sliced preview and changed settings. It is shown before sending when confirmation is needed, and afterwards when an exception applies.

The name virtual is commonly used for proxies and queues such as Bambuddy. It does not guarantee that physical printing cannot start. Never automatically repeat a submission with an uncertain outcome.

Does everything stay on my computer?+

MCP and the recipe library run locally, with no separate project backend. Your AI client may still send model context to the cloud according to its settings. Local MCP does not mean the AI itself necessarily runs locally.

What are settings recipes?+

Recipes bundle settings for a project scope, such as supports or ironing. They live in a local SQLite database outside the app. Revisions, compatibility checks, composition and JSON import/export are supported. Your agent shows changes before applying them; incompatible settings are never silently replaced.

A dump shares recipes; it does not replace a database backup containing operation receipts.

What about Windows, Linux and other printers?+

The bundle has been locally tested on macOS Apple Silicon. The current installer runs on macOS; Windows and Linux are not yet verified. Printing capabilities depend on the device and backend. Support in stock Orca does not guarantee that every action is available to an agent.

How do updates and Bambuddy certificates work?+

Update the app using builds of this fork. An official build will remove AgentControl. New fork builds disable automatic upstream app update checks; the manual update command opens the fork's releases.

MCP updates separately and preserves recipes and journals. The public DMG does not include your personal Bambuddy CA. If you added a certificate inside .app, replacing the app removes that change. Keep the original certificate safe; automatic certificate migration is not implemented yet.
